description: This file contains functions for managing transactions and alerts, including creating transactions, creating alerts, and dismissing alerts, with integration to a Supabase backend.

methods.name: toDateOnly
methods.description: Converts a value to a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: normalizeSeverity
methods.description: Normalizes severity levels to one of 'info', 'warning', 'error', or 'success'.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record for a user into the transactions table.

methods.name: mapAlertRowToUi
methods.description: Maps a database alert row to a UI-friendly alert object.

methods.name: createAlert
methods.description: Creates a new alert for a user in the alerts table.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Marks an alert as read/resolved in the alerts table.
